claim_001.label: SUPPORTED
claim_001.text: File values that satisfy _SupportsRead or expose a read attribute are read, and the returned data is used as the multipart field data.

evidence.note: The changed condition accepts either a _SupportsRead instance or an object with a read attribute before assigning fp.read() to fdata.

claim_001.rationale: The target directly shows the expanded condition followed by the read call and assignment.

claim_002.label: SUPPORTED
claim_002.text: The change was introduced to fix _encode_files detection for file wrappers that proxy attributes through __getattr__.

evidence.note: The commit title explicitly states that it fixes _encode_files detection for __getattr__-based file wrappers.

claim_002.rationale: The stated purpose in the commit message directly identifies the detection problem and affected wrapper type.

claim_003.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_003.text: The change was primarily introduced to improve multipart encoding performance.
claim_003.rationale: No performance objective or optimization appears in the commit message or target diff.

claim_004.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_004.text: The change guarantees complete multipart compatibility with every file-like proxy and wrapper implementation.
claim_004.rationale: The condition checks for a read attribute, but the target and commit do not establish compatibility with every possible proxy or wrapper.
